# EC P-256 certificates for the chain-failure alert tests. Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31 (except chain_future_inter,
# valid from 2040-01-01), all ecdsa-with-SHA256, a fresh P-256 key per certificate. chain_root is the self-signed
# anchor (CN=TlsLib Chain Failure Root); chain_inter (CN=TlsLib Chain Failure Issuer, CA:TRUE) is issued by it and
# chain_leaf (CN/SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth) by chain_inter.
# chain_badsig_leaf names chain_inter as its issuer (same name and key identifier) but was signed by a different key
# held under that same name; chain_anchor_badsig_leaf does the same against chain_root. The signing certificates are
# not supplied.
# chain_crit_leaf (issued by chain_root) and chain_crit_inter (a CA issued by chain_root) each carry a CRITICAL
# private extension (1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1, value NULL); chain_crit_inter_leaf is a plain leaf under chain_crit_inter.
# chain_future_inter (CN=TlsLib Chain Failure Future Issuer, CA:TRUE, notBefore 2040-01-01) is issued by chain_root
# and chain_future_leaf is a plain leaf under it (valid from 2020-01-01).
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z; the two same-name
# signers were self-signed openssl ca certificates reusing the subject key identifier of the certificate they stand
# in for; leaf extension files as described above).
